_note: Narration script for the Team Leader dashboard module (Team Leader guide sections 1 to 4 and 7). Written by Claude from the guide, for the owner to review. Lee voice on eleven_v4, [calmly] prefix. About 70 s, so one take. The prompt spells dsytraining.com as 'D S Y training dot com', CFS and DSY as letters; captions use the text here.

lines.head: Introduction
sentences: Your Team Leader dashboard.
Your whole day, on one screen.

lines.head: Getting there
sentences: Sign in at dsytraining.com with your ambulance ID.
Tap Dashboard on the home page.
Tip: add it to your phone's Home Screen.

lines.head: Roster today
sentences: First, Roster today.
One row per team, one square per hour.
Green is two or more crew.
Yellow is one.
Red is none.
Tap a square to see who's on at that hour.

lines.head: Your tasks
sentences: Next, your tasks.
They're yours: other leaders can't see them.
A red date is overdue.
Amber is due soon.

lines.head: Training sessions
sentences: Training sessions shows what's coming up.
Your next session, and a four-week calendar.
Yellow means a session still needs a lesson.
Tap the count to sort them out in the training app.

lines.head: Dispatch and weather
sentences: Dispatch shows the jobs paged in the last seven days.
The weather flags hot, windy days.
That's your cue to check the CFS fire danger.

lines.head: Ask DSY
sentences: Stuck on something?
Ask DSY.
It answers how-to questions from the guides.
It's not for clinical questions.
And never type in patient details.

lines.head: Summary
sentences: Check the roster.
Clear your tasks.
And make sure every session has a lesson.
